source_evidence.excerpt:
2026-10-19T23:31:31Z
在这里，共居的青年人每月完成不少于50小时的助老服务，可以换取1000元房租减免。这种“代际共居”模式探索为年轻人减轻生活负担，同时为老年人带来富有青春气息的情感陪伴。
中心制定了清晰、可量化的规则：面向22岁至40周岁、南宁市区无自有住房的青年，要求社保缴存满一年，或为全日制本科及以上在读学生。社工、医护、心理疏导、信息技术、文化艺术、法律等专业背景者优先。每月服务满30小时，抵扣500元租金；满40小时抵扣750元；满50小时全额减免1000元月租。中心提供带空调、电视、热水器的单人宿舍，实现“拎包入住”。
“我们首批计划招4人，目前只有小梁一人入驻。宁缺毋滥，宁肯少招，也不降低标准。”谢鸿宏坦言，报名面试的人不少，但能同时匹配专业、性格、时间3个条件的人选并不多。
今年9月，梁银霞上半月工作繁忙，下半月患上重感冒，担心传染老人，主动减少接触，月度服务时长还差4小时。机构没有机械处罚，而是综合实际情况，允许她将缺口顺延至10月补齐。

We took him to the vet and, on the second visit, we were told to rush him straight to the Royal Veterinary hospital because he had tetanus.
Dogs aren’t vaccinated against tetanus because it is so rare, and I don’t think I realised how unwell Orlando was. For the first week it was terrifying. He became completely paralysed and I was awake every night expecting a call to say that he had died. He was too sick to carry on training as a guide dog. He had to learn how to eat, walk and do almost everything again.
When he came back to live with me, he couldn’t go up the stairs. We had to put mats on the floor, because if he slid it would hurt him, and he could manage only short walks. 
In just under six months, Orlando qualified as a guide dog. His new owner, who is partially sighted, had been waiting years for one.

It was 1998, for Pizza Hut at Como, a well-established suburb 15 minutes from Perth’s city centre. 
I spent almost two years working from midnight till 5am every Saturday and experienced the full spectrum of late-night characters out and about in Perth.
There were the pissed clubbers who would prop themselves up against the sneeze-guard and snicker whenever I said “footlong”. There were the beefed-up bouncers and cops whose presence would evoke interest or fear. My boss liked having them around so gave them discounts on their food. 
The sudden appearance of 15 Americans dressed in Fubu and desperate for a taste of home would signal that the sailors were in town – and God help me if I was rostered on solo. They ordered BMT melts (salami, pepperoni, ham, cheese).

By February we were celebrating our first Valentine’s Day together. As a gift, Garrett presented me with an ornate box. Inside I was shocked to discover a real life cow’s heart he’d procured from a butcher, covered in fake blood. 
We both love John Waters – but we’re also lifelong vegetarians and huge animal lovers – which made it all the more potent.
He told me later it was a test to see if I could deal. If this really overly wrought gesture of romance would spook me. If I was horrified, he said, he’d have known I wasn’t the right person for him.
For two decades we’ve been working, living and creating together.

My longterm boyfriend died of cancer last year. We’d been together for 16 years, since I was 21 and he was 23. I had given birth to our only child three weeks before his diagnosis. My son was just shy of 10 months old when his dad died, and he’s now turned two.
Before he died, my partner told me to find a single dad to go out with. When I returned to work, a colleague I had considered a flirt was away – getting chemo. Now he’s in remission. He’s also a single parent. Lately, I’ve realised I have a crush on him. His life has been touched by tragedy and he knows what’s important to him. He’s very kind, like my late partner, and I think we click.
What gives me a lot of pause is that I find him to blow hot and cold. Also, because I’m a solo mum I don’t really have time for someone else. But he has recently left the company, so I wouldn’t be dating a co-worker.

source_evidence.excerpt:
2026-10-19T23:23:23Z
随着气温骤降，柴油车主们迎来了年度“换季”。一些网传的所谓柴油车“加油内幕”也被热议，有人说“柴油颜色越深越耐烧”，还有人称“加油站柴油掺水是行业潜规则”。这些听起来头头是道的“经验之谈”，是真的吗？
国家标准GB 19147—2016《车用柴油》明确规定：“车用柴油中不应含有任何可导致车辆无法正常运行的添加物和污染物。”水含量的指标是“不大于痕迹”。正规加油站所售柴油均按国标严格检测，从油品入库、储存到加注全流程把控质量，合格柴油绝不会人为掺水。

As the planet warms, airlines are grappling with what this means for air travel – and for the passengers who simply refuse to keep their seatbelts fastened
While SQ321 was an extreme case that made global headlines, turbulence is the leading cause of injuries to passengers and crew in non-fatal accidents, according to the International Air Transport Association (IATA). Figures from the Federal Aviation Administration record about a dozen serious injuries a year from turbulence across the US alone.
But the threat of turbulence across the world is increasing due to the climate crisis. Not only will pilots need to contend with the frequency and severity of these episodes rising, they’re facing a future that includes a large surge in clear-air turbulence – an invisible, largely undetectable turbulence that comes, quite literally, out of the blue.
